sourceQuote: 继续完成待进行的修复项，不要等我批准了， 后续的修复我都批准。全部推进修复
authority: Explicit user delegation to select and execute remaining planned local repairs; these precise options are chosen by executor under that authority, not claimed as earlier separately signed text

D-S01-01.rule: Current active, not forced-change actor must have current DB permission and strictly outrank target. Equal/higher rank and administrative self-target denied; applies reset/enable/disable/delete and role change. Role grants must remain strictly below actor rank; no custom role binding enabled. Target and actor rows locked in ascending id order in same business transaction, current user-role grants checked. Account write, refresh revocation and strict audit atomic.
D-S01-01.emergency: No remote bypass or emergency reset route; out-of-band recovery remains excluded/unimplemented. At least protected SUPER_ADMIN cannot be disabled/deleted/reset by a peer.
D-S01-01.compatibility: Existing URLs/body shapes; previously unsafe requests now403; local candidate only, no deployment/migration

D-S01-02.rule: All other authenticated routes deny403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED; refresh remains existing body-token endpoint but cannot bypass resulting restricted access. Revalidate current locked user and force flag during password write; require actual old password for normal change. No IDB/outbox clearing.
D-S01-02.transaction: Password write + refresh revocation + strict audit same tx; any failure rolls back all. No TTL change or security version in this task.

D-S01-04.events: Self normal/force password change, admin reset, any system-role binding change, disable, enable and soft-delete each increments user securityVersion and required refresh revocation in same strict-audit transaction. Current active user/version is checked for every native Bearer request; revoked tokens rejected immediately on subsequent authentication, regardless of JWT expiry. Already authorized in-flight ordinary requests follow their existing tx; account/password commands additionally recheck version in locked tx.
D-S01-04.schema: Add users.security_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT0 with nonnegative CHECK; retain field on rollback. Never rewrite existing migrations, no applied down migration. Old existing users0 preserved, no historical audits modified.
D-S01-04.legacy: JWT missing or mismatched securityVersion denied401, no grace; explicit new login/current valid refresh obtains versioned access. Candidate Web Bearer/body interface and actual TTL unchanged. Legacy target upgrade/logout not executed; old apps that ignore version cannot safely rollback and must be contained, target compatibilityNOT_RUN.
D-S01-04.issuance: After login conditional state reset, locked current row must still match originally checked password hash and version before signing and inserting refresh in same tx; password reset may not turn old-password login into a new-version credential. Refresh current-user lock + revocation existing strict transaction reused.
D-S01-04.logout: Existing family logout contract retained; this task does not claim immediate per-access logout revocation or per-session family JWTs.
D-S01-04.deployment: Local candidate/owned DB only. No production/target migration, account operation or real recovery. Retain columns/deny incompatible old app instead of deleting version guard.
D-S01-04.risk: Immediate old-JWT cutover requires login/refresh and target release validation. Existing in-flight ordinary command boundaries are not globally serialized by auth middleware; current-command locks/CAS still apply.

T-RP-12.rule: All queues/conflicts/dead letters persist per authenticated actor, hidden from other actors and bootstrap/anonymous state. No automatic payload deletion on logout, switch, TTL, quota or failed move. Recovery requires same current actor and fresh authorized project/permission snapshot; no browser-origin data assigned to first login. Pending immutable payload may be exported only by authenticated recorded owner, explicit discard must be separately confirmed and recorded locally. Server mirror cache is not a draft; current owner/permission/project projection and authorization snapshot at most five minutes old. Definitive401/403/404 invalidates fallback; stale login generation cannot read/write/delete newer partition. Offline inability to know server revocation is bounded by five minute cache lease; target policy acceptance not claimed.

T-RP-09-RP11.rule: Use existing tokenStore actorId + loginGeneration, separate from refresh tokenRevision. Verified authenticated profile activates owner partition; bootstrapping merely pauses and hides, anonymous logout deactivates matching generation only without payload deletion. Capture owner/generation before every asynchronous operation; IndexedDB transaction checks current authority and persistent generation fence before any write. Device id partitioned by actor. API does not accept inferred owner.
